upgrade_plan.title: Booking Flow UX Improvements - Upgrade Plan

issues_addressed.title: Failed to create a client record error
issues_addressed.description: When selecting credit card payment and clicking 'Pay Now', user receives 'Failed to create a client record' error. This is a new error that needs investigation and fixing.
root_cause_analysis: Stripe client creation API call failing
Missing error handling for client creation step
Possible issue with guest details not being properly formatted for Stripe
API endpoint may be missing required fields

fixes.action: Investigate API endpoint for creating Stripe client
fixes.details: Check if guest details are properly passed to Stripe client creation
Add try-catch blocks and user-friendly error messages for client creation failures

fixes.action: Validate guest data before API call
fixes.details: Ensure all required fields (email, name, phone) are present and valid before attempting Stripe client creation
Implement retry logic for transient failures with exponential backoff

issues_addressed.title: Missing scroll indicator for booking content below
issues_addressed.description: The booking widget should always have visual clues that the booking experience continues below. Users don't realize they need to scroll down, especially when bank transfer instructions appear below the payment method selection.
root_cause_analysis: No visual indicator when content extends below viewport
Bank wire instructions appear below payment selection without scroll hint
Widget content area may not show scroll indicators
Mobile users especially affected as viewport is smaller

fixes.details: Create a reusable scroll indicator that shows when content is scrollable below. Should include animated chevron/arrow pointing down with 'Scroll for more' text
Use IntersectionObserver or scrollHeight comparison to detect when content extends below viewport

fixes.action: Add scroll indicator to ReviewAndPay step
fixes.details: Show scroll indicator when bank wire instructions are visible but below viewport, or when payment method section has content below

fixes.action: Add 'Jump to payment instructions' button for bank transfer
fixes.details: When bank transfer is selected, show a prominent button that scrolls to bank instructions section
When user selects bank transfer, automatically scroll to show instructions (with smooth animation)

issues_addressed.title: Back button functionality and visibility
issues_addressed.description: Users need a way to go back and edit previous steps. Currently there's a back button but it may not be obvious enough, or users don't realize they can edit previous information.
root_cause_analysis: Back button exists but may be disabled when it shouldn't be
Back button styling may not be prominent enough
Users may not understand they can go back to edit
No visual feedback when going back

fixes.action: Ensure back button is always visible and enabled (except on first step)
fixes.details: Review back button logic - should be enabled on all steps except the first one

fixes.action: Improve back button styling and visibility
fixes.details: Make back button more prominent with better contrast, larger size, and clear icon. Add hover states and focus states for accessibility

fixes.action: Add confirmation when going back with unsaved changes
fixes.details: If user has entered data in current step, show confirmation dialog before going back (optional, can be configurable)
Add tooltip on hover: 'Go back to edit previous step'

issues_addressed.title: Step indicators should be clickable links
issues_addressed.description: The step indicators at the top should be clickable links that allow users to jump to any previous step. Currently they're just visual indicators. Some users won't understand they're links unless made extremely obvious (e.g., 'Jump to step 2 of 5').
root_cause_analysis: No visual indication that steps can be clicked
Users expect step indicators to be navigation elements
Missing accessibility features (keyboard navigation, ARIA labels)

fixes.details: Convert step circles to buttons/links that navigate to that step. Only allow navigation to completed steps or current step (not future steps)

fixes.action: Add visual feedback for clickable steps
fixes.details: Add hover states (cursor pointer, scale effect, color change), active states, and disabled states for future steps
Add text like 'Jump to [Step Name]' or 'Step 2 of 5' on hover. Consider adding a small 'click to edit' icon or text
Add action to jump to specific step: `jumpToStep(stepNumber)`. Validate that step is accessible (completed or current)
Support arrow keys and Enter/Space for keyboard navigation between steps
Add proper ARIA labels: 'Step 2: Options - Click to edit', role='button', aria-current='step' for current step

issues_addressed.title: Email field behavior when clicking payment method
issues_addressed.description: User mentioned 'I guess this is gonna be changed for the email, right?' - suggests confusion about email field behavior when selecting payment method. May need clarification or better UX.

fixes.details: Ensure email field is clearly displayed and not confusing when payment method is selected. Email should be visible in guest information section
If email is used for payment, add clear indication. Otherwise, ensure it's clear email is for booking confirmation

implementation_order.title: Critical Fixes
tasks: issue-1: Fix 'Failed to create a client record' error
issue-2: Add scroll indicators and jump buttons

implementation_order.title: Navigation Improvements
tasks: issue-3: Enhance back button visibility and functionality

technical_considerations.details: Use IntersectionObserver API for efficient scroll detection. Fallback to scrollHeight comparison for older browsers.
Only allow navigation to completed steps or current step. Prevent navigation to future steps that haven't been completed yet.
Ensure step navigation preserves user data. Consider showing confirmation if navigating away from step with unsaved changes.
Scroll indicators and jump buttons should be touch-friendly with adequate hit targets (min 44x44px).
All interactive elements must be keyboard accessible, have proper ARIA labels, and meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards.

testing_checklist: Test credit card payment flow end-to-end
Verify 'Failed to create client record' error is fixed
Test scroll indicators appear when content is below viewport
Test 'Jump to instructions' button for bank transfer
Test auto-scroll on bank transfer selection
Test back button on all steps
Test clickable step indicators (completed steps only)
Test keyboard navigation for step indicators
Test on mobile devices (iOS Safari, Android Chrome)
Test on desktop (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Test with screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver)
Test error handling and retry mechanisms
success_criteria: No 'Failed to create client record' errors when using credit card payment
Users can clearly see when content continues below (scroll indicators visible)
Users can easily navigate back to previous steps
Users can click step indicators to jump to completed steps
Bank transfer instructions are immediately visible or have clear jump button
Mobile experience is smooth and intuitive
